nodes.label: 8,557-Item Official Furniture Catalog
nodes.rationale: furniture_official_catagory.json (misspelling preserved from the delivered source filename) holds 8,557 unique IDs that must match the GLB manifest exactly and the 8,557 item IDs covered by 25,671 images — every item has one front, one side and one angle-45 view.

nodes.label: GLB Upload Manifest
nodes.rationale: Keyed by item_id with verified S3/CloudFront results; original_glb_path is producer-relative provenance, not a runtime path, and runtime delivery uses object_key and the HTTPS delivery_url.

nodes.label: BGE-M3 Furniture Embeddings (7,958)
nodes.rationale: furniture_embeddings_bge_m3.jsonl carries 7,958 vectors generated by Django for PostgreSQL/pgvector persistence. All 8,557 items have VLM/RAG description fields, but only the 7,958 rag_indexable rows are active; the remaining 599 stay outside the official API and vector RAG pending review.

nodes.label: RAG Ownership Boundary (Django vs Kai)
nodes.rationale: Django owns RAG metadata, text, vector generation, retrieval and quality; Kai's only RAG duty is persisting Django's delivered vectors to PostgreSQL/pgvector. RAG supplies retrieval evidence only — placement legality stays in backend/engine/.

nodes.label: Legacy Payload and Appliance Exclusion Policy
nodes.rationale: The legacy 10,550-item and 9,349-item payloads and the legacy PostgreSQL importer were removed. Appliances are not part of the current product and legacy rows must not enter the API, Agent, official furniture set, database or scene; the current 8,557-item set is validated with the two --dry-run import scripts.
